title: Construction Area Daily Safety Inspection Checklist
description: Completed by Apron Supervisor or OM daily during any active construction or major maintenance project. Submitted

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

items.text: Construction area boundary cones/barricades in place and complete no gaps
All barriers frangible (not rigid) no solid structures in safety areas
Cone spacing ≤ 7.5 m along all active boundaries
Retroreflective material on all cones and barriers adequate for current visibility
Obstruction lights on all barriers (red, steady or flashing) operational if evening/night works
No non-frangible structures, equipment, or stockpiled materials within RESA or runway strip without BDCA approval
All stockpiled materials contained (aggregate, concrete, HMA) no loose windblown material
No loose fasteners, tools, or small materials visible on or near movement area
Construction vehicle FOD check log completed for all vehicles entering operational area
Contractor FOD walk of construction site completed for this shift (confirm with Site Safety Officer)
No FOD from construction site found on operational pavement areas
All temporary pavement markings required by Construction Safety Plan in place and visible
Temporary markings clearly distinguishable from permanent markings
All temporary signs in place per Construction Safety Plan
No permanent markings obscured without temporary equivalents installed
Operational runway surfaces no debris, no equipment, no material from construction zone
Operational taxiways no debris or material from construction zone
No construction equipment parked within safety area outside designated construction zone
All construction vehicles have visible PGIA airside identification
All construction personnel wearing high-visibility vests
Construction site radio communications confirmed operational
Current NOTAM accurately reflects scope of construction closure/restriction
No work has exceeded the scope of the current NOTAM
If works scope has changed, updated NOTAM issued before proceeding

signoffs.label: Contractor Site Safety Officer acknowledgment (Name / Signature)

validationRules: Every item marked NO SAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Generated by scripts/pmm-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph or rule position.
Item codes are the ones PRINTED on the approved form — they are not synthetic and must not be renumbered.
